user.title: Device Availability Digest
user.description: Automatically discover compatible devices and a notification target. Review the suggested notification entity, then complete setup. The old device-availability automation should be disabled first.

init.description: Advanced entity lists accept comma-separated entity IDs. Excluded device anchors exclude all entities belonging to the same registered device. Connectivity overrides use on=healthy and off=disconnected.
